incidents.summary: Breedon subsidiary Whitemountain Quarries was fined €1.2 million after pleading guilty to roadworks safety breaches that the court attributed to the deaths of a father and two children.

sources.title: Letterkenny Circuit Court: Roadworks company fined €1.2m after father and two children die in lough - BBC News
sources.quote: A roadworks company that pleaded guilty to health and safety breaches has been fined €1.2m at Letterkenny Circuit Criminal Court following the deaths of a man and two children.

sources.title: Letterkenny Circuit Court: Roadworks company fined €1.2m after father and two children die in lough - BBC News
sources.quote: Judge Roderick Maguire said three people had died due to the failures of Whitemountain Quarries Limited.

sources.title: Company fined €1.2m over breaches after fatal crash
sources.quote: Whitemountain Quarries Limited, a Breedon Group company, pleaded guilty to breaches of the Safety, Health and Welfare at Work Act 2005.

incidents.summary: A court fined Breedon Group €350,000 for endangering quarry workers in a blasting incident involving flyrock.

sources.title: Breedon Group receives dangerous blasting fine - Cement Sector News - Global Cement
sources.quote: UK: A court has fined Breedon Group Euro350,000 for endangering workers at one of its quarries.

sources.title: Breedon Group receives dangerous blasting fine - Cement Sector News - Global Cement
sources.quote: Environmental Data Services News has reported that a blast caused a flyrock projection event as workers set off explosives at the quarry.

positives: Breedon Cement received a Distinction Award at the NISO/NISG Annual Safety Awards.
Breedon signed a 15-year agreement with RWE to supply approximately 70 GWh of renewable electricity annually to its Great Britain sites.
Breedon's CDP Climate Change rating improved from B to A- in the first half of 2025.
Breedon upgraded its Dublin Port Bitumen Terminal with modern boilers and flue gas economisers to improve energy efficiency and enable natural-gas operation.
